---

Hello! Welcome to the blog portion of my website. I aim to use this space to keep track of ideas and helpful tips and tricks that I come across.

Although I'm not limiting the content of these posts to anything in particular they will most likely be related to **data science**, **data management**, **documentation** and anything that I think would be useful for other people, especially those trying to keep on top of data-related things in a lab setting. 

The posts will likely be a combination of things that I am discovering as I go and reflections on things that I have learnt during my time as a research scientist. For this reason, the posts will mostly be aimed at other beginners and people such as myself that start working in a lab with very little programming knowledge. Suffice to say as a disclaimer from the start, I am by no means an expert in the things that I will write about. I almost certainly will make mistakes and strongly welcome comments, corrections and suggestions.

Thank you for taking the time to read this and stay tuned for the first "offical" post.
